id.description: The unique identifier of the LLM

default.description: Indicates if this is the default LLM for its type

tenantId.description: The ID of the tenant this LLM belongs to

creatorId.description: The ID of the user who created the LLM

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the LLM was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the LLM was last updated
